::: {.home-hero-text}
<h1>Altair charts in the World Bank Group style</h1>

Attaviz applies the
[World Bank Group Data Visualization Style Guide](https://worldbank.github.io/data-visualization-style-guide/)
to Altair. Run `attaviz.enable()` and every chart uses the theme.

[Read the quick start](getting-started/quickstart.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[See the gallery](gallery.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::

::: {.home-hero-chart}
```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd

import attaviz

attaviz.enable()

source = pd.read_csv("data/wdi-southeast-asia-2023.csv")

chart = attaviz.bar(
    source,
    category="country",
    value="life_expectancy",
    title="People in Malaysia and Thailand live the longest",
    subtitle="Life expectancy at birth, years, 2023",
    highlight=["Malaysia", "Thailand"],
)

attaviz.frame(
    chart,
    description="Horizontal bars of life expectancy in seven Southeast Asian countries; Malaysia and Thailand are highlighted.",
    source="World Development Indicators",
    source_url="https://databank.worldbank.org/source/world-development-indicators",
)
```
:::
:::
